description: This Java test class 'BulkWriteResultAckFlowTest' tests the behavior of 'BulkWriteResultAckFlow' in the context of MongoDB bulk write operations. It verifies how acknowledgments are handled for successful, partial, and failed bulk write results, including error cases such as socket exceptions and index bounds errors. The tests utilize Akka Streams and the JUnit framework to simulate MongoDB responses and ensure correct processing and logging of write outcomes.

classes.name: BulkWriteResultAckFlowTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for 'BulkWriteResultAckFlow' which tests acknowledgment handling of MongoDB bulk write results, including success, partial success, and error scenarios, utilizing Akka Streams and mocking MongoDB responses.

methods.name: stopActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the Akka ActorSystem after each test to clean up resources.

methods.name: allSuccess
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment processing when bulk write operation is fully successful.

methods.name: partialSuccess
methods.description: Verifies correct handling when bulk write has partial success with errors, particularly non-duplicate key errors.

methods.name: unexpectedMongoSocketReadException
methods.description: Ensures flow handles MongoSocketReadException as an unexpected error, triggering failure acknowledgments.

methods.name: errorIndexOutOfBoundError
methods.description: Checks behavior when bulk write errors contain invalid index references, expecting all updates to be marked as failures.

methods.name: runBulkWriteResultAckFlowAndGetFirstLogEntry
methods.description: Runs the Akka Stream flow with given write result and retrieves the first log message.

methods.name: generate5WriteModels
methods.description: Helper to generate sample write models for testing purposes.

methods.name: expectUpdateThingResponse
methods.description: Simulates expectation and retrieval of an 'UpdateThingResponse' message from the test probe.
